crossRefs.note: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.
Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good…
The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.
In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.
According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity, and sow trouble, reap the same.
The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.
He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.
Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.

translations.web: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
translations.bsb: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
translations.kjv: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
translations.asv: He hath made a pit, and digged it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.
